_format: camera_id -> {lines: ["x1,y1,x2,y2:POS:NEG", ...], notes}. Coordinates are normalized [0,1]; POS is the direction assigned when a track crosses onto the line's positive side (below a left-to-right horizontal line), NEG the reverse.

tva43.notes: Calibrated on 2026-08-09 night clip: placed at the track-center median (detect_track --stats y_p50=0.563) so short nighttime tracks still cross it. Receding traffic (taillights, up-frame) assumed EB because the inventory says the camera faces East. VERIFY direction mapping with daytime commute flow; re-run --stats on daytime clip and re-center.
